items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for the aliencouncil.com SEO/CTA test; blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch. The SEO test is ordinary, reversible growth work on a live site with healthy analytics and no new data collection, affiliate expansion, or external spend. Proceed only if source attribution, consent behavior, disclosures, accessibility, and existing analytics remain unchanged; do not make unsupported UAP, savings, affiliate, or authority claims. SearchWoot remains private because upstream redistribution rights, data-flow, privacy, security, accuracy, measurement, and owner gates are incomplete.

Compliance evidence is a technical baseline, not certification: 37 sites pass, 16 fail, and 6 are unknown; open findings include banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms issues. Analytics is healthy for aliencouncil.com. Telemetry gaps and aggregate revenue do not block this bounded SEO test, but no revenue, ROI, causal lift, or site-attributed commission should be claimed. The 2026-09-21 affiliate evidence shows 10 clicks and $0 attributed commission for aliencouncil.com.

Launch-readiness progress: 0 of 4 SearchWoot checklist tasks are evidenced as complete; none may be closed. The current disposition remains keep_private. The next evidence actions are: attach authoritative source-rights evidence or a counsel-reviewed permission request; produce the read-only alert data-flow and retention table; capture deployed GA4 consent and property settings; and inventory logs, vendors, incident handling, deletion, correction, and access procedures.
